description.text: Chemical engineering and Technology is an engineering discipline based on chemistry, physics, mathematics and other disciplines, which studies the design, development, optimization and operation of chemical engineering production processes and related equipment. It not only focuses on the chemical reactions themselves, but also emphasizes the transformation of chemical achievements in the laboratory into practical applications in large-scale industrial production, solving engineering problems such as efficiency, cost and environmental protection in production.

duration.text: The Chemical engineering and technology at Northwest University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.
